data.code_commit_message:
feat(cpu): align simulator with hardware pipeline design

Fix critical pipeline bugs (JAL writeback, BHLEQ branch, J sign extension,
M1 fallthrough, BZ_T/BZ_N opcodes, MFHI/MFLO), add bubble injection during
stalls, SW store data forwarding, LIU/LIL byte forwarding, virtual peripherals,
pointer-based peripheral attachment, and meson build system.

All 9 anem16pipe basic tests passing.
